name: Genevieve Schwab

death.place: Sun City West, Maricopa County, Arizona

residences.note: Residence five years before the 1940 census

bioAdditions: In 1940 Genevieve, 26, lived with her husband Nicholas at 1028 Bunker Hill Street; in 1935 she had been living in Taylor (S1). FamilySearch gives her life as 1914 (Old Forge) – 2004 (Sun City West, Arizona), with a GenealogyBank obituary index entry (S2).

sources.citation: 1940 US census, Scranton Ward 10, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 71-64, sheet 4B (enumerated 20 Apr 1940), Bunker Hill Street nos. 1020-1028: households of James 'Petranello' (28), Nicholas 'Petranello' (29), Charles 'Petranello' (33), DiBiasi (1022) and Genello (1020).
